title: Pollymorph
tagline: Pollymorph multiple NFTs together on chain, wrapping the original assets so you can unwrap them at anytime
description: The ability to take multiple game awards/nfts and mix and match them anyway you want while still having the security of owning a token with wrapped tokens, this contract also gives you the ability to unwrap these tokens and alter them at anytime. We also use IPFS to store this data in an agreement with a live interaction allowing you to mix the art live!
how_its_made: This project uses Polygon/Matic as the chain that powers everything, WalletConnect for wallet interactions, ENS for domain name and avatars, tetum to pull live data on the price of matic, store all of our NFT data on IPFS, next.js for the front end, fastify.js for the backend and ethers.js for all connections as well as pinata to upload to IPFS directly
